From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@elliptica.com>, procurement@elliptica.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: legal handoff & redline cadence — confirmation and next steps

Hi Daniel / Elliptica team — thanks again for the demo earlier. Per the call, attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-RW-ELP-v0.3.pdf) with milestone owners and rough dates. This thread is to confirm the legal milestone (MSA / DPA / SLA) owners, expected turnaround times (TAT), and dependencies so we can lock the close target into the MAP.

Summary of the legal milestone in the MAP (section 4):
- Milestone: Contract execution (MSA + DPA + SLA appendix)
- Target close: 2027-05-06 (tentative, dependent on legal cadence)
- Redwood owner: Laura Bennett (Legal) — primary for Redwood edits
- Elliptica owner: Daniel Park / Procurement — primary for customer redlines
- Dependencies: Procurement window, security questionnaire artifacts, and final pricing attachment

Action items requested (please confirm):
1) Daniel / Procurement: share consolidated redline file (MS Word redline preferred) and any procurement constraints.
2) Laura: confirm Redwood redline TAT and whether a 3 business day turnaround for first-pass edits is workable.
3) Aditya: coordinate DocuSign flow and staging for signature once redlines are settled.
4) Marissa: note any operational dependencies (SLA metrics we promised) so legal has the right appendix text.

Attachments: MAP-RW-ELP-v0.3.pdf (draft milestones)

If we can lock the redline cadence today, I will update the MAP and set the formal close date. Thanks — Marcus

--

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@elliptica.com>, procurement@elliptica.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: legal handoff & redline cadence — confirmation and next steps

Thanks Marcus — happy to own Redwood's side of the MSA/DPA/SLA redlines. A few clarifications from legal: 

- Preferred input format: please provide a single consolidated tracked-change Word doc for the MSA + a separate DPA redline if possible. That prevents parallel-file merge conflicts.
- Redwood commit: initial commercial/legal pass within 3 business days after receipt of a consolidated redline, provided the redline set is focused (i.e., not 200+ page blanket edits).
- Exceptions: if the redlines raise substantive security/compliance items (SOC 2 scoping, data residency clauses, HSM/KMS specifics), we will need up to 5 business days to coordinate with Security & IR.
- DPA: we will parallel-review the DPA, but require the security questionnaire artifact (completed security questionnaire or snapshot of SOC 2 scope) to close the DPA.

Operational ask to Aditya / Marcus: when you send the redline, include a short summary (2–3 bullets) of the non-negotiables (e.g., data residency, retention, indemnity caps) so Legal can prioritize. Also please route the Word file to laura.bennett@redwoodai.com and cc legal@redwoodai.com.

I will treat this as high priority. If Elliptica indicates a longer procurement window, we can set staged TATs in the MAP (initial pass = 3 biz days, full resolution = 10 biz days).

Laura Bennett
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodai.com
--
Note: I will attach a redline guidance checklist to the thread once I finalize it (formatting/turnaround expectations).

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: legal handoff & redline cadence — confirmation and next steps

Thanks — I'll consolidate Elliptica's redlines as soon as I receive the individual comments from your side. Marcus: I'll ask Procurement to provide a single merged Word file (or point me to their tracked-changes doc). I'll also confirm the internal procurement blackout windows; if they block signature windows in late April we should shift the MAP close target accordingly.

Proposal from my side: if Elliptica can turn around initial redlines in 5 business days, Redwood legal will attempt 3 business days for a first pass; if Elliptica needs more time, let's agree to a 4 business day first-pass to be conservative. Can we update the MAP target close to 2027-05-13 as a buffer? Thoughts Marcus / Laura?

-Aditya

Marcus / team — appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick update from procurement: the internal calendar is tight the week of 4/11 due to quarter-end reviews, so Elliptica can produce a consolidated redline by 2027-04-15 (5 business days from today). I've attached a short note on procurement constraints (Elliptica-procurement-constraints.pdf).

Regarding turnaround, procurement asks that Redwood commit to a 5 business day TAT for the initial pass to ensure we have time to align internally before your legal response. Is that acceptable? If Redwood needs an expedited path we can prioritize a core set of clauses (data handling, indemnity, retention) for faster review.

On the positive side: procurement confirmed no special third-party escrow or marketplace listing is required at signature.

Thanks — Daniel

Thanks Daniel — noted. To find middle ground: Redwood Legal (Laura) will commit to a 4 business day initial turnaround once we receive the consolidated redline on 2027-04-15. If you can highlight the 3 highest-priority clauses in the submission (data handling, indemnity, retention), Laura's team will triage those for an accelerated response within 2 business days.

Updated MAP items I will commit to updating today: 
- Legal milestone TAT: Redwood initial pass = 4 business days after consolidated redline receipt (target first-pass date 2027-04-21)
- If Elliptica provides prioritized clause list, Redwood will attempt 2 business day triage for the prioritized items
- Revised close target: 2027-05-13 (buffered) — I will update the MAP doc and the HubSpot deal to reflect this.

Next steps (owners):
- Daniel / Procurement: deliver consolidated redline (Word) by 2027-04-15, include prioritized clause bullets 
- Aditya: consolidate and forward redline to laura.bennett@redwoodai.com (cc legal@redwoodai.com) on receipt
- Laura: initial pass within 4 business days; escalate security questions to Security & IR as needed (5 business day exception)
- Marissa: confirm SLA appendix language and attach to the MAP by 4/16

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Wed 4/21 to triage outstanding items after Redwood's initial pass — calendar invite to follow. Thanks everyone for the flexibility.

Best —
